description:
Search Nostr for kind:1 notes matching hashtags using NIP-12 #t filter. No wallet required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default: 20).

relay.description: Single relay URL to query. Defaults to all DEFAULT_RELAYS.

tags.description: Comma-separated hashtags to search for (e.g., 'bitcoin,nostr'). Do not include the '#' prefix.

name: nostr_search_tags
